==Biography==
Zachary "'''mancloud'''" Allan Hoschar's first competitive League of Legends team was [[APictureOfAGoose]], which he founded in early 2011 along with [[Atlanta (James Moreland)|Atlanta]], [[wallstop]], [[berard]], [[voyboy]], and [[3xecutioner]]. The team won several [[Go4LoL]] tournaments in 2011 and 2012 and played at [[IGN_Proleague_Season_3_-_Atlantic_City|IPL 3]]. They also qualified for [[IEM_Season_VI_-_Global_Challenge_Kiev/Qualifiers|IEM Kiev]] but were unable to attend due to external conflicts.

mandatorycloud stayed with the team through several acquisitions and renamings: first [[MTw_North_America|mTW]], then [[Monomaniac_Ferus|Monomaniac]], next [[Team FeaR]], and finally [[Team Vulcun]]. With Vulcun, he qualified for the first-ever [[Riot_League_Championship_Series/North_America/Season_3/Spring_Round_Robin|NA LCS split]], and despite a weak start to the season they finished fifth in the regular season and ended the [[Riot_League_Championship_Series/North_America/Season_3/Spring_Playoffs|playoffs]] in third.

===2014 Season===
Following the [[Riot_League_Championship_Series/North_America/Season_3/Summer_Round_Robin|season 3 summer split]], Vulcun renamed to [[XDG Gaming]], and mandatorycloud shortened his name to '''Mancloud'''. The team also changed their roster, moving [[Xmithie]] to AD Carry and placing [[Zuna]] in the jungle. The role swap was not well-received by the community, who thought that the team was going to suffer as a result, and XDG placed last in the [[Riot_League_Championship_Series/North_America/2014_Season/Spring_Round_Robin|LCS summer split]] and were subsequently relegated by [[LMQ]].

After XDG was relegated from the LCS, [[Benny (Benny Hung)|Benny]], Mancloud, [[Zuna]], and [[Sheep (Jamie Gallagher)|Sheep]] left the team. In early May, Mancloud joined [[Curse Academy]] as their starting midlaner, and he played with the team in the [[2014_NA_Challenger_Series/Summer_Series|first]] and [[2014_NA_Challenger_Series/Summer_Series/Series_2|second]] series of the NACS summer series. However, after being replaced by [[Keane]] as the starting midlaner for the [[2014_NA_Challenger_Series/Summer_Series/Playoffs|playoffs]], he left the team on August 17.<ref>http://www.twitlonger.com/show/n_1s4c2ro</ref>

===2015 Preseason===
Mancloud, once again competing under the name '''mandatorycloud''', joined [[Storm (North American Team)|Storm]] in September 2014, a team formed to attempt to qualify for the [[Riot League Championship Series/North America/2015 Season/Spring Season|2015 spring LCS]] via the [[Riot League Championship Series/North America/2015 Season/Spring Expansion|Expansion Tournament]]. However, because their top laner [[Lourlo]] would not be 17 years old in time, they decided to wait until he would be eligible to compete to attempt to qualify.

In October 2014, mandatorycloud stated that he wanted to try out for LMQ (as AD Carry) and was trying out for [[Counter Logic Gaming]], hoping to fill vacant roster swaps for the [[Riot_League_Championship_Series/North_America/2015_Season/Spring_Round_Robin|2015 LCS]].<ref>[http://www.facebook.com/mandatorycloud/posts/638667866243124 mancloud's Facebook Post] ''facebook.com''</ref> However, he was not given either position.

===2015 Season===
After the fourth week of the [[Riot League Championship Series/North America/2015 Season/Spring Season|Spring LCS Split]], [[Team Coast]] was at a 1-7 record. They replaced [[Jesiz]] with Mancloud going into the fifth week.<ref name="mancloud coast">[https://www.facebook.com/TeamCoastGaming/photos/922384321134870 Coast's Facebook Post] ''facebook.com''</ref> However, the team lost their remaining spring split games and ended the split with a 1-17 record, automatically relegated to the [[2015 NA Challenger Series/Summer Season|NACS]].

On May 1, 2015, mancloud announced his free agency.<ref>[https://twitter.com/mandatorycloud/status/594382992211976193 mancloud's Tweet] ''twitter.com''</ref> He later rejoined Storm. Storm renamed to '''Maelstrom Gaming''' for the qualifier, but after a first-round victory over [[Aware Gaming]], they lost to [[CLG Black]] and were eliminated; shortly after, Maelstrom disbanded, and Mancloud joined [[Team Imagine]] as a substitute mid laner. After the second week, he moved to a starting position, when the team replaced their entire starting roster.

Imagine finished fourth in the regular season, with a 6-4 record. In the 2015 NACS [[2015_NA_Challenger_Series/Summer_Playoffs|Summer Playoffs]], they lost in the semifinals to eventual tournament winner [[Renegades]], but won the third place match against [[Cloud 9 Tempest]] to secure a spot in the [[Riot_League_Championship_Series/North_America/2016_Season/Spring_Promotion|2016 LCS Promotion Tournament]]. Chosen by [[Team 8]], they lost 3-1 - out of [[League Championship Series/North America/2016 Season/Spring Promotion|LCS]] qualification, but regardless retaining their [[2016 NA Challenger Series/Spring Season|2016 NACS spring season]] placement. Mancloud left Imagine in November.<ref>[http://www.twitlonger.com/show/n_1sns246 Parting Ways With Imagine] ''twitlonger.com''</ref>

== Trivia ==
* Was considered one of North America's best mid laners in Season 3.
* Has six ducks, two geese, a dog, and a cat.
